review_candidates.title: Head of Business Development, Europe - QUICKBLOCK
review_candidates.description: ABOUT QUICKBLOCK QUICKBLOCK is an innovative and scaling Scottish business providing rapidly deployable modular infrastructure across a range of sectors including defence and security, humanitarian and disaster relief, construction, events and agriculture. With a highly adaptable product platform and growing international customer base, defence and security have become the principal focus for the next stage of the company’s growth. Headquartered in Stirling, Scotland, and led by CEO Andrew Vincent, QUICKBLOCK is at an exciting stage in its development. Andrew has led the commercialisation and growth of the business as it has increasingly focused on defence and international markets, supported by an experienced Board and investor base. Having established its product and built a growing customer base in the UK and Europe, QUICKBLOCK is now focused on scaling internationally, with Germany, Poland and the Nordics identified as key growth markets. At the heart of the business is QUICKBLOCK’s innovative flat-packed, interlocking building system. Lightweight, reusable and highly adaptable, the system enables structures to be assembled quickly without specialist tools or permanent construction and can be dismantled and reconfigured as requirements change. Within defence and security, QUICKBLOCK is used to create military and police training environments, the ability to rapidly create and adapt realistic training scenarios provides customers with a flexible and cost-effective alternative to traditional fixed infrastructure. THE OPPORTUNITY QUICKBLOCK is looking to accelerate its commercial development across Germany, Poland and the Nordics, where increased defence investment and demand for flexible training solutions are creating significant opportunities. The European Business Development Lead will take ownership of developing these markets, combining direct engagement with military and security customers with the management and development of regional agents and partners. A key focus will be to convert existing market activity into contracted revenue and progress from individual unit-level sales towards larger, more strategic opportunities. Reporting directly to the CEO Andrew Vincent, the role offers considerable autonomy to shape QUICKBLOCK’s European commercial approach, establish a sustainable presence across the region and play an important part in the company’s next phase of growth. THE ROLE This is a hands-on commercial role requiring an entrepreneurial mindset, with the successful candidate expected to create structure, build momentum and take ownership for developing and converting opportunities across the region. Operating as a senior individual contributor, they will spend significant time in-market, engaging military and procurement stakeholders, supporting demonstrations and trials, and managing and developing the QUICKBLOCK agents, distributors and partners strategy. The role requires independence, commercial discipline and a willingness to get hands-on, without relying on the infrastructure of a larger corporate environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITES Drive commercial growth across Germany, Poland and the Nordics, opening new and lucrative markets and converting an existing pipelines. Develop relationships with military and security end-users, procurement organisations, defence ministries, primes and other strategic stakeholders. Take ownership of opportunities from initial engagement through to contract award. Lead and develop QUICKBLOCK’s network of European agents and distributors, improving performance and identifying gaps in market coverage. Generate customer demand through demonstrations, trials, events and direct engagement with military and security customers. Identify and navigate the appropriate procurement routes and defence supply chains within each market. Develop strategic account plans for priority customers and programmes. Work with internal teams to develop compelling proposals, bids and commercial presentations. Maintain strong commercial discipline across CRM, pipeline management, forecasting and reporting. Provide relevant market intelligence and competitor insight to support QUICKBLOCK’s wider European strategy. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES Entrepreneurial and self-starting, comfortable creating structure and momentum within a scaling business. Commercially driven and competitive, with a strong motivation to win and deliver results. Credible and personable, able to build trusted relationships across military, government and industry. Hands-on and pragmatic, comfortable operating independently without significant corporate infrastructure. Resilient and disciplined, able to maintain momentum through complex defence sales cycles. Culturally aware and adaptable, with the ability to operate effectively across European markets. Ambitious and collaborative, attracted by the ownership and influence available within a growing international business. HOW TO APPLY For more information please click the following link to view the candidate brochure: click to open For further information or a confidential discussion, please contact Daryl Harper on +44 (0) 131 539 7087, or visit our website to apply with your CV.

review_candidates.description: It's more than a job In a world of constantly evolving trade dynamics, you'll play a key role in connecting markets, translating insights into strategy, and driving commercial success on a global scale. But that is not all. Your work also helps ensure that vital medicines reach patients on time and supports other essential deliveries, from wind turbines to semiconductors. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine. ‎ As a Trade Specialist within our Sea Logistics organization, you will play a key role in supporting the development and execution of trade strategies across the Transpacific Eastbound trade. Working closely with regional teams in Europe, Singapore, and North America, you will help drive volume growth, carrier performance, and commercial excellence while ensuring alignment across key stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded sea freight professional who combines strong analytical skills with the ability to build relationships, influence decisions, and deliver results in a global environment. How you create impact Support the execution of trade strategies and daily activities across the assigned trade lane, collaborating closely with teams in Europe, Singapore, and North America. Build and maintain strong relationships with shipping lines and carrier partners to secure competitive commercial agreements and service levels. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with carriers, monitor performance, and support the resolution of operational and commercial escalations. Coordinate and support RFQ and tender activities, ensuring competitive pricing and alignment with business objectives. Analyze market trends, carrier performance, capacity developments, and trade data to identify opportunities and support strategic decision-making. Prepare reports, presentations, and business insights for internal stakeholders, supporting trade reviews and performance discussions. Collaborate closely with sales, pricing, allocation, and operational teams to drive volume growth and maximize trade performance. Manage key trade information platforms and reporting tools while maintaining visibility of carrier allocations, contract commitments, and commercial performance metrics. What we would like you to bring Minimum 5 years of experience in sea freight, freight forwarding, shipping lines, carrier management, or a related logistics environment. Strong knowledge of international ocean freight operations, including FCL, LCL, import, and export processes. Proven commercial acumen with experience negotiating with carriers, suppliers, or key business partners. Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into actions. Experience supporting tenders, RFQs, pricing activities, or procurement-related processes. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging senior internal and external stakeholders. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools; familiarity with market intelligence platforms is an advantage. Fluent English is required; additional languages such as German, French, or other European languages are considered a plus. What's in it for you At Kuehne+Nagel, you will become part of one of the world's leading logistics companies, working within a truly international environment and collaborating with colleagues across multiple regions. You will benefit from a collaborative culture, flexible working arrangements, and a workplace that values innovation, development, and long-term career success. Who we are Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world. As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine. Wir glauben an die Innovationskraft der Vielfalt in unseren Teams. Inspired by people – inspired by you? Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

review_candidates.title: Country Manager
review_candidates.job_function: General Business, Business Development, and Strategy/Planning
review_candidates.description: Our client (HQ in Abuja, Nigeria) is part of a European group of investors with a strong expertise in energy infrastructure and logistics for semi-solid and liquefied hydrocarbon products in Africa. The family owned company develops and operates state-of-the-art production facilities, complex distribution models and a highly specialized logistic network to service demanding industrial customers in Africa. Its mission is to establish reliable, competitive and sustainable energy solutions in regions where traditional infrastructure is lacking, thereby supporting both industrial development and socio-economic growth. To establish and scale its operations in other West- & Central African countries such as Ghana, Ivory Coast, Benin, Mali, Niger and BurkinaFaso the company is seeking to appoint experienced and entrepreneurial : Country Managers West-& Central Africa Oil & Gas Industry Your Mission : Lead the market entry and operational rollout of the company’s LNG-based energy solutions in your assigned country. Identify, develop and secure locations for LNG import terminals, storage facilities, regasification units and refueling stations. Manage permitting and regulatory processes with authorities, ensuring compliance and timely approvals. Establish the local legal entity, governance and operational framework. Build and lead the initial local organization (project, logistics, operations, commercial support). Design and implement the “virtual pipeline” logistics model, including LNG supply via trucksand/or vessels, storage,inland distribution and delivery to industrial clients. Develop partnerships with key stakeholders: suppliers, port authorities, transport partners, industrial off-takers and energy-intensive customers. Oversee development, installation and commissioning of terminals, regasification systems and downstream infrastructure. Ensure operational readiness and ramp-up, including safety, reliability and service continuity. Manage budgets, CapEx deployment and risk, ensuring disciplined execution and reporting to Group HQ. Act as the company’s representative and ambassador in-country, ensuring compliance, credibility and long-term positioning. Your Profile : To qualify for this position you ideally have a successful Senior-level experience managing downstream logistics and distribution of hydrocarbon products (e.g. LNG, LPG, Bitumen...). An existing and active network of relevant industrial, business and institutional stakeholders in one or more target countries in West & Central Africa. The ability to navigate downstream regulatory frameworks, port clearance and overland transportation and logistic challenges across West- and Central African territories. Experience in site selection, permitting, and regulatory compliance, preferably in energy, oil & gas, logistics or industrial infrastructure projects. Proven senior leadership experience in establishing new country operations or industrial projects in frontier/emerging markets. The ability to build organizations from scratch: legal setup, governance, HR, operations. High level of autonomy,pioneering mentality and entrepreneurial drive. Financial and operational acumen: ability to manage budgets, CapEx deployment, and deliver against milestones. Strong communication and negotiation skills,with proficiency in both English and French, depending on the country of operation. Cultural fluency, resilience, and diplomatic tact to operate effectively in complex political and socio-economic contexts. Willing and able to live and work in the country of assignment, with flexibility to travel across West- & Central Africa. Offer : A unique opportunity to lead a high-profile, long-term market entry project in Africa. This position is open to both international expatriates and host-country nationals. Remuneration and benefits will be tailored to the candidate's residency and assignment status.

review_candidates.description: Intitulé du poste Chef de Projet ServiceNow H/F Localisation : Paris Rattachement Direction des Systèmes d’Information (DSI) / Direction des Opérations IT Contexte Dans le cadre du développement et de l’évolution de sa plateforme ServiceNow , l’entreprise recherche un(e) Chef de Projet ServiceNow pour piloter des projets de transformation et d’optimisation des processus IT et métiers. Le/la Chef de Projet ServiceNow intervient de la phase de cadrage jusqu’à la mise en production et assure la coordination des différentes parties prenantes : équipes métiers, équipes IT, administrateurs et développeurs ServiceNow, intégrateurs et partenaires externes. Il/elle est garant(e) du respect des objectifs, des délais, des coûts et de la qualité des projets qui lui sont confiés. Missions principales 1. Pilotage des projets ServiceNow Recueillir et analyser les besoins des métiers et des équipes IT. Organiser et animer les ateliers de cadrage et de conception. Définir le périmètre, les objectifs, les livrables et le planning des projets. Construire et suivre les plans projet, budgets et charges. Identifier les risques, dépendances et points de blocage. Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance du projet. Assurer le reporting auprès des sponsors et instances de gouvernance. Piloter les phases de recette, de déploiement et de mise en production. Organiser la conduite du changement et accompagner les utilisateurs. 2. Gestion fonctionnelle ServiceNow Traduire les besoins métiers en exigences fonctionnelles ServiceNow. Rédiger les expressions de besoins, spécifications fonctionnelles et user stories. Participer à la définition des processus cibles. S'assurer de la cohérence des solutions avec l'architecture et la stratégie ServiceNow de l'entreprise. Challenger les solutions proposées par les équipes techniques ou les intégrateurs. Superviser la configuration et les développements réalisés sur la plateforme. Veiller au respect des bonnes pratiques ServiceNow et des règles de gouvernance. 3. Coordination des équipes Coordonner les équipes internes et externes intervenant sur les projets. Organiser et animer les comités projet et comités de pilotage. Assurer l'interface entre les métiers, la DSI, les équipes ServiceNow et les partenaires. Prioriser les demandes et arbitrer les sujets en fonction des enjeux business et IT. Faciliter la résolution des incidents et problèmes rencontrés dans le cadre des projets. 4. Déploiement et conduite du changement Préparer les stratégies de déploiement et de migration. Piloter les phases de tests et de recette utilisateur. Coordonner la documentation fonctionnelle et technique. Préparer les supports de communication et de formation. Accompagner les utilisateurs lors des changements de processus ou d'outils. Mesurer l'adoption et la satisfaction des utilisateurs après mise en production. 5. Amélioration continue Identifier les opportunités d'optimisation de la plateforme ServiceNow. Suivre les évolutions de la roadmap ServiceNow. Proposer des améliorations fonctionnelles et organisationnelles. Contribuer à la définition et au respect de la gouvernance ServiceNow. Capitaliser sur les retours d'expérience et mettre en place les actions d'amélioration. Périmètre fonctionnel ITSM : Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog CMDB / ITOM IT Asset Management / HAM / SAM IT Business Management HR Service Delivery Customer Service Management ServiceNow SPM Portail utilisateurs / Employee Center Intégrations avec les systèmes SI existants Automatisation et optimisation des workflows Compétences requises Compétences fonctionnelles Maîtrise de la gestion de projets IT. Bonne compréhension des processus ITSM. Bonne connaissance de l'écosystème ServiceNow. Capacité à formaliser et prioriser les besoins métiers. Maîtrise des méthodes de conception et de recette fonctionnelle. Connaissance des problématiques d'intégration entre ServiceNow et le SI. Compétences techniques Une bonne compréhension, sans nécessairement être développeur, de : Architecture ServiceNow. Modules et applications ServiceNow. Workflows et automatisations. CMDB et modèles de données. APIs et intégrations. Import Sets / interfaces. Gestion des rôles et droits. Environnements de développement, test et production.
